source_review.notes: Checked all fifteen primary references. DORA platform measurement and research materials, CNCF platform/product guidance, Google funnel and internal-platform documentation, and GOV.UK performance, completion, take-up and satisfaction guidance support the bounded current claims.

evidence: Reviewed entity, journey, cohort, ordered-stage, observation-window, qualifying-set, conversion, event-time, stage-latency, retention, mandate/assistance, guardrail and outcome notation.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation keeps team/person/service entities, cohort eligibility, stage semantics, time and outcome constraints distinct.

evidence: Executed the synthetic closed-funnel audit and reproduced eligible=12, aware=11, evaluated=9, first_value=8, retained=6, expanded=4, awareness_to_value=72.7%, value_to_retention=75.0% and funnel_invariants=pass.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The nested sets conserve the declared cohort, 8/11 rounds to 72.7 percent and 6/8 equals 75.0 percent.

evidence: Verified closed-funnel subset relations, stage conversion denominators, undefined zero-denominator handling, event-time latency, retention eligibility and outcome/guardrail constraint.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The formulas apply only to aligned entity, journey, cohort, version and windows and explicitly defer open funnels to transition logic.

evidence: Reviewed forced migration, inherited use, operator completion, multi-interface paths, retries, duplicates, late events, cohort censoring, ineligibility, low-frequency journeys, missing telemetry, small-segment privacy, novelty effects, contamination, support dependence, resource sprawl and exit lock-in.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Coverage spans identity, semantics, time, cohorts, product incentives, causality, privacy, accessibility, operations, cost and lifecycle boundaries.

evidence: Traced semantic, cohort, evidence, outcome, ethical and decision invariants through instrumentation, conversion, retention, expansion, drop-off, experiments, exit and metric operation.
invariant_checking.notes: The invariants prevent interface-event substitution, denominator drift, duplicate inflation, outcome-free growth, surveillance and dashboard-without-decision behavior.

evidence: Verified two capabilities with identical 95 percent retention: one voluntarily reused for value and one mandated with prohibitive exit cost.
proof_review.notes: Identical retention with different satisfaction and value correctly refutes retention alone as sufficient product-success evidence.

evidence: The retention counterexample is explicitly labeled a proof sketch and names construction, consequence and stronger evidence.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No funnel, conversion target, stage order or causal analysis method is represented as a universal theorem.

evidence: The funnel audit is explicitly synthetic and disclaims universal targets; examples are scenarios; guidance is retrieval-dated; no real adoption result or experiment effect is claimed.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No real team behavior, migration result, survey, productivity gain, causal effect or external review is presented as observed evidence.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed journey decisions, eligibility, stage semantics, cohorts, windows, events, interfaces, conversion, time/effort, retention, expansion, safe exit, drop-off, interventions, experiments, outcomes, privacy and metric operations.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed implementability with materialized eligibility, stable cohort identity, semantic events, correlation/deduplication, accepted outcomes, assistance labels, late-data correction, nested-set audits, cohort maturity, journey research, predeclared guardrails, privacy suppression and metric ownership.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified required order, one-page review, definitions and formulas, twelve-step mechanism, six invariants, bounded proof sketch, executable audit, eighteen trade-offs, thirty misconceptions, ten examples, ten connections, fifteen references, and five answered exercises.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
